resources.string: NEC2 Engine. Open the NEC-2 website

OpenNEC 2.4.1. Free space, perfectly conducting round elements, a voltage source at the driven element center and 50 Ω reference impedance. Forward gain is along the boom toward the directors. F/B compares 0° and 180°.
NEC requires straight-element model dimensions. Mounted dimensions support proportional scaling.
The feed model for a driven element with a physical gap is awaiting verification. Scaling remains available.
The OpenNEC engine is unavailable on this device.
